tasks.title: Add rebaseOntoMaster method to WorktreeManager
tasks.description: Add rebaseOntoMaster(worktreePath, baseBranch) method to WorktreeManager that fetches latest origin/baseBranch, auto-commits uncommitted changes, then runs git rebase inside the worktree. On conflict, abort rebase and return conflictingFiles list. Simplify mergeBack() to use --ff-only instead of --no-edit merge.
acceptanceCriteria: rebaseOntoMaster() fetches origin/baseBranch and runs git rebase origin/<baseBranch> inside worktreePath
Uncommitted changes in worktree are auto-committed before rebase
Rebase conflict triggers git rebase --abort and returns { success: false, conflictingFiles: string[] }
Successful rebase returns { success: true }
mergeBack() uses git merge --ff-only instead of git merge --no-edit
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: D1: rebase runs in worktree for full file context. D6: mergeBack simplified to ff-only after rebase

tasks.title: Rewrite MergeQueue.processItem with rebase-first flow
tasks.description: Rewrite MergeQueue.processItem() to: (1) check for no-commits case, (2) set mergeState to 'rebasing', (3) call rebaseOntoMaster(), (4) on rebase failure set 'conflict' and emit rebase_conflict, (5) on success set 'merging', (6) call mergeBack() (now ff-only), (7) run build verification, (8) on build failure rollback. Update handleFailure to support 'blocked' state. Extend MergeEntry with retryCount, lastAttemptHead, changedFiles fields.
acceptanceCriteria: processItem transitions: pending -> rebasing -> merging -> merged on success
Rebase conflict sets mergeState to 'conflict' and emits rebase_conflict event with conflictingFiles
No-commits case skips rebase/merge, cleans worktree, sets 'merged'
Build failure after ff-merge triggers rollback and sets 'build-failed'
MergeEntry interface includes retryCount, lastAttemptHead, changedFiles fields
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: This is the core flow change. retryCount starts at 0, incremented in auto-retry (T-005)

tasks.title: Implement conflict-aware merge ordering in pickNext
tasks.description: Override pickNext() to detect file overlap between pending issues using git diff --name-only. Cache changedFiles on MergeEntry. When multiple pending issues overlap, prioritize by FIFO order. Degrade gracefully to FIFO on git diff failure.
acceptanceCriteria: pickNext() computes changedFiles for each pending issue via git diff --name-only
changedFiles is cached on MergeEntry (computed once per issue)
When issues A and B have overlapping files, A (earlier enqueue) is processed first
When no file overlap exists, FIFO order is used
git diff failure logs warning and falls back to FIFO ordering
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: D4: use git diff --name-only with caching. Degrades to FIFO on failure

tasks.title: Add auto-retry scheduler for blocked issues
tasks.description: Add startAutoRetry() method to MergeQueue that runs a setInterval (5 min default). Each tick: find entries with mergeState 'conflict' or 'blocked', compare master HEAD (git rev-parse) against lastAttemptHead, if changed re-enqueue as 'pending' and emit rebase_retry. Increment retryCount; when retryCount >= 5, set 'blocked' and emit merge_blocked. Update retry() to accept 'blocked' state in addition to 'build-failed' and 'conflict', and reset retryCount to 0. Update recoverFromDB() to also recover 'conflict' and 'blocked' issues. Add stopAutoRetry() method.
acceptanceCriteria: startAutoRetry() starts a periodic timer (configurable interval, default 5 min)
Timer detects master HEAD changes via git rev-parse and re-enqueues eligible issues
retryCount increments on each auto-retry, capped at 5
Reaching retry limit sets mergeState to 'blocked' and emits merge_blocked event
Manual retry() accepts 'blocked' state, resets retryCount to 0, and processes immediately
recoverFromDB() recovers issues with mergeState 'conflict' or 'blocked' into the queue
stopAutoRetry() clears the interval (called on shutdown)
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: D3: setInterval + master HEAD comparison. retryCount is memory-only (resets on restart)

tasks.title: Wire auto-retry into server startup and shutdown
tasks.description: Update server/index.ts to call mergeQueue.startAutoRetry() after recoverFromDB(), and mergeQueue.stopAutoRetry() in the SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers. Ensure the existing agent_completed handler still enqueues into mergeQueue.
acceptanceCriteria: Server startup calls startAutoRetry() after recoverFromDB()
SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers call stopAutoRetry()
agent_completed handler unchanged (still enqueues)
Typecheck passes
Build passes
